grounding_ceiling_definition: questions with no successful rollout among 8 Stage 1 rollouts (T 0.7) where some failed rollout is a grounding recall failure: no top-5 grounding of the policy's FINDs reaches the gold answer or the reference entity (a rollout that never wrote the answer or reference FIND is a policy failure, not a recall failure); found on a 180-question Stage 2 collection. Left out of the Stage 2 SFT set: there is no avoidance rule to teach.
operation_ceiling_definition: questions the temporal operations cannot express (none identified for MultiTQ yet)
gold_finer_than_question_definition: gold time answer finer than the granularity the question asks for ('In which year ...' with a gold YYYY-MM-DD); a scoring artefact, not a decision to correct
